mentions.name: Nittany Nights / Indy After Five
mentions.description: Event promotion websites that surface live music shows and drink specials happening tonight by aggregating listings from local venues' Instagram accounts, so users don't have to check dozens of accounts themselves. Built on a custom site-parsing toolkit that removes friction with existing solutions and makes it easy to add new locations quickly to scale; currently running as the Nittany Nights and Indy After Five sites.
mentions.problem: Finding out what live music and drink specials are happening tonight currently requires checking dozens of Instagram accounts.
mentions.audience: People deciding what to do tonight who want to find live music and drink specials without checking dozens of Instagram accounts
mentions.source_excerpt:
Software to promote live music and drink specials so I don't have to check dozens of Instagram accounts to find out what's happening tonight.

https://nittanynights.com/

https://indyafterfive.com/

I wrote my own site parsing toolkit which removed the friction I have with the current ones. It's now easy to add new locations quickly to scale.
mentions.author: ipunchghosts
